listing.name: Felyne Puzzle / Airu de Puzzle — ailu-puzzle (jM5557)
listing.summary: The project reports early play of menus, story and first puzzles. This is a title-specific Yakumo fork for Felyne Puzzle, a separate game from Monster Hunter. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese NPJH50614 game data.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow this project’s instructions to generate a local executable, AppImage or APK from your own game. Do not redistribute the generated files. This guide does not identify a ready-made player download.

warnings: The project reports early play of menus, story and first puzzles. This is a title-specific Yakumo fork for Felyne Puzzle, a separate game from Monster Hunter.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
